scenarios.context: Two classmates talk about their best friends.

speakerA.en: What's your best friend like, Hana?
Is she outgoing, or is she a quiet person?
That sounds lovely. Is there anything you don't like about her?
Everybody has weak points. A good friend is more important than a perfect one.

speakerB.en: She's very kind and generous. She always shares her lunch with me.
She's quite shy with strangers, but she's very funny when she knows you.
Sometimes she's a bit stubborn. She never changes her mind, even when she's wrong.
I agree. I'm lucky to have her in my life.

scenarios.context: A girl compares her two brothers.

speakerA.en: Are your brothers similar, Nina?
Which one is more ambitious?
And Kaveh? What are his strong points?
It's interesting how different brothers can be.

speakerB.en: Not at all. Omid is calm and patient, but Kaveh is impatient and gets angry quickly.
Omid, I think. He studies hard because he wants to become a doctor.
He's very creative. He draws, writes songs and always has new ideas.
Yes, and they argue a lot, but they really care about each other.

scenarios.context: A teacher talks to a student about speaking in class.

speakerA.en: Sam, you're one of my best students, but you never speak in class.
Many people feel the same way. Do you think it would help to speak in a small group first?
Then let's start with group work this week. I'll ask you only easy questions.
Mistakes are part of learning. I'm sure you will become more self-confident.

speakerB.en: I know. I get nervous when everybody looks at me.
Maybe. I'm more confident when I talk to just two or three people.
That would be good. I'm afraid of making mistakes.
Thank you, Miss Rahimi. I'll try my best.

scenarios.context: Two students describe a teacher they like.

speakerA.en: Who's your favourite teacher this year?
What makes him special?
I like teachers who are enthusiastic about their subject.
I'd like to be that kind of teacher one day.

speakerB.en: Mr Tehrani. He's strict, but he's also fair and very patient.
He listens to every student, and he never laughs at our mistakes.
Me too. When he talks about history, he's so passionate that everybody wants to listen.
You would be great. You're polite, honest and good at explaining things.

scenarios.scenario: What kind of person are you?
scenarios.context: Two friends do a personality quiz in a magazine.

speakerA.en: The quiz says I'm an optimist. I always look on the bright side.
What does it say about you?
I agree with the first part. You ask a lot of questions about everything.
Quizzes aren't always right, but this one describes us well.

speakerB.en: That's true. You never worry, even before exams.
It says I'm curious and independent, but sometimes I'm too serious.
And you're a loyal friend. You always tell the truth, even when it's difficult.
Let's ask our other friends to do it. I'm curious about their results.
